item.text: {"decision":"clarify","rationale":"The report supplies the affected package/version, environment, package paths and warning. However, the webpack snippet references an absent `tsconfig.angular.json` and does not supply the compilation entry points, build dependency setup or triggering command. The preserved playground contains only a comment directing readers back to the report. The package listing permits inspection of the published files, but does not reconstruct how `types.ts` enters the Angular compilation and produces the reported warning.","clarification":"Could you share a minimal runnable Angular/webpack project that emits this warning, including `tsconfig.angular.json`, the relevant `webpack.config.js` and compilation entry points, `package.json` and a lockfile, plus the exact build command or package-script invocation? The package listing and extension settings alone do not show how `@eslint/plugin-kit/dist/esm/types.ts` becomes part of the Angular compilation."}
